tasks.title: 2021 - Volcanic paroxysms of Etna
tasks.statement: Case study based on the 2021 volcanic paroxysms of Mount Etna, Sicily. Utilizing remote sensing data (Sentinel satellites), GPS time series, seismological records, and geological data to explore the volcanic activity, its impacts, and monitoring methods.

parts.question: What is the best combination of spectral bands to visualize, to distinguish and to differentiate lava flow, ash plume, vegetation, clouds and snow in a single image? (1A: True color, 1B: False color, 1C: Moisture index, 1D: SWIR)
What is the exact location (in decimal degrees) of the downstream point reached by the lava at 9.50am on that day?
Knowing that the volcanic eruption started at about 08:00 am. What are the correct answers regarding lava flow speed and distance?
By comparing various eruptions (08/04/2017, 26/12/2018 and 28/02/2021) visualize the lavas flow emitted, and answer the following question.
How would you characterize the lava of Etna based on microscope images and samples?
What is the best hypothesis on the identity of the rock thus formed? The rocks of Etna belong to the family of: (rhyolites, diorites, andesites, basalts)
In what situations is the lava flow a real danger to people and infrastructure?
In which direction did the ash plume disperse into the atmosphere on 28 February 2021?
Comparing the images taken by Sentinel-2 over the period 26 February 2021 to 3 March 2021, which is the most appropriate answer?
Looking at Sentinel-5 images, what elements appear to be present in the high-altitude ash plume of 28 February?
In the days following 28 February, in which countries could we expect to see the most ash from the volcano in the atmosphere?
Which are the most correct answers regarding atmospheric ash particle size and effects?
Once ash falls to the ground, it solidifies over time and turns into rock. What rock can be produced by the deposit and the consolidation the volcanic ash?
In what areas can volcanic ash cause inconvenience to people?
Choose the correct situation for the period between 13 February to 25 March regarding horizontal and vertical GPS movements.
By examining the evolution of the beacons between 13 February and 25 March, choose the correct conclusions.
Discover the ground motion recorded (dayplot) at these three stations from 26 February to 21 March 2021 and identify the volcanic activity pattern.
Which statements are correct regarding the local earthquakes recorded in Sicily between 19 and 22 March 2021?
Which statements are correct regarding the location of seismicity in relation to the volcano Etna?
Locate the epicentre of the 21 March earthquake using Tectoglob3D.
By analysing the seismogram recorded at EVRN station, find out how long it took for the first seismic wave train to reach the station and evaluate its propagation speed.
Make a screenshot of your work with the virtual globe, the epicenter location designed by circles, local seismicity, seismograms.
According to your study, indicate the events that can directly impact the population.
